## Checklist

- [ ] Commit messages follow [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `BREAKING CHANGE:` in the footer if relevant) — see `VERSIONING.md`.
- [ ] If this adds a verb or flag: checked against the self-critique checklist (not a disguised `--type` fork of something that already exists) and cross-checked against [clig.dev](https://clig.dev/).
- [ ] If this changes existing behavior: it follows the staged deprecation policy in `VERSIONING.md` (a `WARN`-level stderr line, not a silent change), unless this is a genuine bug fix.
- [ ] `cargo build` and `cargo test` pass locally.
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated under the right heading (NOTES/FEATURES/IMPROVEMENTS/BUG FIXES).
